svg.text: (a) A fixed budget, shifted between A and B
bid on type A, b_A (the B bid follows from the budget)
higher A bid → less money left for B
(b) One bid level, very different win rates
win rate in this auction type
bid needed for this win rate
Both auction types have the same value and volume but different competition. At the optimum the bids are equal, yet A takes 75% of the budget and wins 3.9× as often
